data.standardized_narrative: In 2017, Syndicate 1200 experienced an overall deterioration of GBP 53.7m in prior year reserves. This was primarily driven by the impact of significant natural catastrophe events in the US, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, as well as wildfires in California and earthquakes in Mexico. These events led to a strengthening of loss reserves, particularly in short-tail lines of business such as US Direct & Facultative, Cargo, Yachts & Hull, which had already experienced significant rate pressure and unsustainable losses in prior years (2015 and 2016). Reserve increases were also noted in some casualty lines due to large loss events. The deterioration reflects the challenging market conditions and the need to strengthen reserves for business written in 2015 and 2016.
